title: Home Use of Oxygen

change_log.author: CarePolicyGuard Regulatory Informatics
change_log.summary: Statutory citation mapping against CMS Pub 100-03 Manual Section 240.2.

description: CMS coverage for long-term home oxygen therapy in chronic respiratory disease. Requires documented arterial blood gas PaO2 <= 55 mmHg or SaO2/SpO2 <= 88% at rest on room air, clinical stability at time of testing, and absence of acute reversible etiology.
scope_note: Curated benchmark criterion schema targeting primary statutory indications, exclusions, and waiting periods; not an exhaustive legal transcription of full multi-page CMS coverage manuals.

criteria.name: Resting Hypoxemia (PaO2 <= 55 mmHg or SpO2 <= 88%)
criteria.description: Arterial blood gas PaO2 <= 55 mmHg or pulse oximetry oxygen saturation (SpO2) <= 88% measured at rest on room air in a stable state.
criteria.clinical_intent: Objective demonstration of severe chronic resting hypoxemia
criteria.source_section: Section B: Group I Medical Documentation Requirements
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Arterial blood gas PaO2 at or below 55 mm Hg, or an arterial oxygen saturation (SpO2) at or below 88% measured at rest.

criteria.name: Clinical Stability at Evaluation
criteria.description: Documented evidence that qualifying oximetry or arterial blood gas testing was performed in a chronic, clinically stable state and not during an acute illness or hospital exacerbation.
criteria.clinical_intent: Enforce CMS requirement for chronic clinical stability prior to long-term home oxygen authorization
criteria.source_text_excerpt: The qualifying arterial blood gas study or oximetry test was conducted in a chronic, clinically stable state.

criteria.name: Acute Reversible Etiology Exclusion
criteria.description: Exclusion: Patient has an active, acute reversible etiology of hypoxemia (e.g. acute untreated pneumonia, acute bronchospasm, or transient pulmonary edema) amenable to treatment.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude transient hypoxemia from long-term home oxygen coverage
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Oxygen therapy is non-covered for conditions where hypoxemia is transient or reversible by standard treatment.
